note: T76's store-policy checklist. EVERY row starts OPEN or PENDING_REVIEW. This repository may not mark a row APPROVED: store acceptance is a human, external decision and any APPROVED row here that no human wrote would be fabricated external approval, which the project forbids. The structure is what is owed now; the verdicts arrive with the reviewer.

rows.requirement: Data-safety form answers match the exact signed binary's actual behaviour
rows.evidence_required: derived from the signed artifact plus the aggregated manifests, not from intent

rows.requirement: Every declared permission/entitlement is justified, and no debug-only capability ships
rows.evidence_required: manifest + entitlements inspection at the signed build; ci/check_release_surface.py green

rows.requirement: Privacy labels declare no tracking and no collected data for this target
rows.evidence_required: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and the Play data-safety form, read from the signed build

rows.requirement: Account/deletion obligations do not apply, or are satisfied
rows.evidence_required: a statement of whether the target creates an account at all

rows.requirement: Redistribution rights cover the bundled Archive
rows.evidence_required: the approved production corpus and its rights evidence

rows.requirement: Store listing, screenshots and in-app copy mention no prohibited claim
rows.evidence_required: the prohibited-claim list in docs/production/RELEASE_METADATA.json matched against the listing

rows.requirement: Dependency licences are compatible with distribution
rows.evidence_required: docs/supplychain/SBOM.json licence_census, including its UNKNOWN rows resolved or accepted
rows.blocked_by: human review; native/model licences arrive with T62-T65/T81

rows.requirement: Export/encryption declarations match the shipped cryptography
rows.evidence_required: the shipped primitive inventory, read from the signed binary

rows.requirement: Content rating questionnaire matches the bundled Archive
The store accepts the submitted build
rows.blocked_by: SIGNING, then store submission -- external by definition

why_prohibited: A status this repository can write is not an external approval. If a future change needs to record a real store verdict, it records the store's artifact (a URL, an id and a hash) rather than a self-assigned word.
